patterns: APPSC asks one-line site facts: measuring scale = Lothal, close external contact = Mesopotamia, Indus region called Meluhha.
Other PSCs repeat 'animal not known/not depicted' (horse; cow on seals) and 'metal not found' (iron).
Earliest-agriculture items are keyed inconsistently across PSCs (Mehrgarh vs Lahuradeva); avoid statement items that make either one 'incorrect'.
App MCQs go much deeper (scale materials, plough models, Gujarat port lists, seal shapes) than the simple PYQs; match/statement format dominates the app.
